text:
alex: noticed got a cascade of argocd sync failures on the app-of-apps root, looks like a helm pre-sync hook is bailing because namespaces can't be created due to a ResourceQuota denial :grimacing:

rachel: any error output from argocd or helm?

alex: argocd shows: `pre-sync hook failed: failed to create namespace "ml-gpu-pool": admission webhook "quota-validator" denied the request`

jihoon: that sounds like the namespace now has a strict quota from the infra terraform change last night. if the chart tries to create the namespace with resources above quota it will fail the presync.

maria: do we have the exact admission error? can you paste the k8s event?

alex: pasted events:
```
Normal  SuccessfulCreate  30s  namespace-controller  Created namespace ml-gpu-pool
Warning FailedCreate       29s  namespace-controller  Admission webhook "quota-validator" denied: requested: cpu=2000m,memory=10Gi, limited to: cpu=1000m,memory=4Gi
```

linh: ahhh so helm chart sets default namespace-level resource requests for GPU daemonset/serviceaccount. Chart used to assume we had a higher quota. Terraform change reduced clusterwide namespace quotas to control cost.

jihoon: that explains why GPU autoscaler didn't spin new nodes — the resources couldn't be bound into the namespace so pending pods stayed pending, HPA/autoscaler didn't see eligible pods to scale.

alex: workaround idea: temporarily create the namespace manually with the higher ResourceQuota so pre-sync succeeds, then remove quota after rollout. low risk?

rachel: risky during production but ok as a short-lived mitigation. prefer to patch the chart to not set namespace resources and let infra own quotas.

maria: we should also avoid letting helm pre-sync create namespaces if infra owns them. we can patch app-of-apps to set `createNamespace: false` for this chart in the immediate term.

linh: steps I propose:
1) patch app-of-apps app to set createNamespace:false for ml-gpu chart and set a canary sync to force skip namespace creation
2) commit a chart change to drop aggressive namespace-level resource defaults and open PR against infra to reconcile desired quotas
3) temporarily apply a higher quota to ml-gpu-pool namespace to unstick the current sync if needed

alex: doing step 1 now. will update the app manifest and re-sync the specific child app.

deploy-bot: Started sync for app ml-gpu-pool (canary) by alex at 1976543350

alex: sync failed again but different error: `helm: pre-sync hook timed out` - looks like the hook is retrying because the pod that runs the presync checks is stuck Pending (ImagePullBackOff) due to node selectors for GPU that hit no nodes.

jihoon: that's the other half — nodes weren't created because the pending pods can't be scheduled due to quota issue earlier. now it's a chicken-and-egg.

maria: temp measure: patch the presync hook in chart to skip heavy checks when a flag `SKIP_PRESYNC_HEAVY=true` is set, and set that flag in the canary then revert after infra fix.

linh: I can apply the manual namespace quota bump for 30m, that should allow scheduling and let autoscaler detect and create nodes. will document and remove after rollout.

alex: done, bumped namespace quota and re-triggered sync at 1976543495

deploy-bot: Sync succeeded for ml-gpu-pool at 1976543520 :tada:

rachel: can we follow up with a postmortem: root cause = terraform quota change in infra that wasn't coordinated with chart assumptions + helm presync creating namespaces. action items: update chart defaults, add preflight gating in infra PRs, and add an argocd policy to avoid presync namespace creation for infra-owned namespaces.

jihoon: I'll open the infra PR to revert the quota change and propose a safer rollout strategy (staged quota reduction with communication).

maria: I'll open a patch to the chart to remove namespace resource defaults and add SKIP_PRESYNC_HEAVY flag for hooks.

linh: I'll create an ops playbook snippet and schedule a short oncall runbook so next time we can fast-unblock with documented steps.

alex: recording incident notes in /docs/incidents/gpu-quota-argocd-presync.md and will add timestamps and commands used. thanks all :heart:

sre-bot: Incident created: GPU quota / argocd presync outage (INC-2026-0423) — pager duty responders notified.

rachel: closing loop — will follow up with PR links and timeline in the incident doc later today.
